task_instance: Use the ui-ux-pro-max skill to generate a complete design system (pattern, style, colors, typography, effects, anti-patterns) for an elegant beauty spa wellness service landing page named 'Serenity Spa', via the skill's required command: python3 scripts/search.py "beauty spa wellness service elegant" --design-system -p "Serenity Spa" -f markdown.
blocker_detail: The skill's core stated deliverable is produced only by executing its bundled Python CLI (scripts/search.py with the --design-system flag), which searches five CSV domains in parallel and applies reasoning rules from ui-reasoning.csv via design_system.py and core.py to select and assemble the recommended design system. The office-assistant runtime cannot run code, scripts or shell commands of any kind and has no Python interpreter available to it, so the CLI cannot be invoked. The bundled scripts (search.py, design_system.py, core.py) and all required data CSVs are present next to SKILL.md, so this is a runtime execution limitation rather than missing skill files, and the run rules forbid writing my own replacement/stub of the bundled script or fabricating its reasoning output.
evidence: Read the SKILL.md at the skill path: its How-to-Use workflow mandates Step 2 'Generate Design System (REQUIRED)' by running python3 .claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py <keywords> --design-system, with further steps also invoking search.py (--domain, --stack). Glob of the skill directory confirmed the bundled scripts/search.py, scripts/design_system.py, scripts/core.py and the full data/ CSV set (products, styles, colors, typography, landing, charts, ux-guidelines, ui-reasoning, stacks/*, etc.) are all present. The deliverable (the generated design system output of search.py) therefore inherently requires executing Python, which the stated office-assistant runtime does not grant (read/write/edit text files and web fetch/search only; no code execution). No shell or code was run. result.json written to the work directory at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r116/result.json.
